_comment: Read by node 6 (Code: Load Content Context). Replace <...> placeholders with your actual site data. Categories & tags MUST be copied from your existing WordPress site (GET /wp-json/wp/v2/categories?per_page=100) so the AI selects from available ones, not inventing new categories.

site.name: satryapudja.wordpress.com
site.niche: Philosophy (classical & modern, including philosophy of science — naturalism, evolution, philosophy of creation) and niche psychological opinion/perspective (specific psychological phenomena, including tips for conditions like ADHD/anxiety) — NOT general self-help/self-improvement, NOT clinical information presentation
site.audience: Curious, reflective readers — interested in deep philosophical perspectives and well-reasoned opinions on psychological phenomena, not seekers of generic self-help advice or clinical diagnoses
site.contentStyle: Mostly OPINION/PERSPECTIVE (deep-dive argumentative), not neutral encyclopedic reporting — see tone.stance below and GEO_SCORING_RUBRIC.md §5a (adjusted in CP 002)

tone.voice: reflective, argumentative but measured — deep-dive, not shallow listicle
tone.person: second person (you) — not formal 'Anda', not circular 'we'
tone.stance: Taking an explicit stance/opinion is allowed and ENCOURAGED — BUT every stance MUST reference a specific thinker/theory/study (philosopher name, psychological theory name, study name), not thrown out without basis. See GEO_SCORING_RUBRIC.md §5a.
avoid: hype/clickbait language (EVERYONE was WRONG, revolutionary, you MUST know this)
filler opening sentences (in this digital era, as time progresses)
vague attribution (many experts, according to research) — ALWAYS name the specific philosopher/theory/study
generic self-help/self-improvement style (5 ways to be better, generic productivity tips)
medical/clinical article style (diagnosis, treatment protocols) — this is not the niche, and the Safety Guard will reject topics requesting such personal advice
prefer: explicit references to philosopher names/theories/schools of thought or specific psychological studies
comparison of perspectives (e.g., two philosophers with opposing views on the same issue)
mention trade-offs/limitations of arguments, not just one side
concise sentences that stand alone meaningfully when quoted individually

author._comment: Used for WordPress byline + JSON-LD author (E-E-A-T signal). Framing: independent writer/researcher synthesizing research & thought — NOT claiming to be a licensed clinical psychologist or formal philosophy academic, unless actually true. False credential claims risk damaging site credibility if checked by readers.
author.name: Satrya Pudja
author.jobTitle: Independent writer & researcher — philosophy and psychology
author.bio: An independent writer critically exploring perspectives on meaning, existence, and the human condition through philosophy and psychology. Also shares a firsthand account of living with and recovering from ADHD and anxiety — informed by personal experience in therapy and a sustained self-study of the psychological frameworks behind these conditions.

wordpress._comment: WordPress.com site (CP 001) — NOT self-hosted. Auth via OAuth2 generic credential in n8n (Authentication: Body), not Application Password/Basic Auth. categories & tags MUST be numeric IDs from your WP; fetch via GET {restApiBase}/categories and {restApiBase}/tags, don't let the AI make up new category names.
wordpress._categoriesNote: IDs fetched via GET {restApiBase}/categories (CP 002 step 2). Created automatically via n8n helper workflow.

categories.name: Classical & Modern Philosophy
categories.useWhen: Deep-dive into philosopher perspectives (classical or modern) on a question/phenomenon — not biographical summaries, but argument analysis

categories.name: Philosophy of Science
categories.useWhen: Philosophical issues in science: naturalism, evolution, philosophy of creation, limits of scientific method — still framed as philosophy, not popular science articles

categories.name: Psychological Opinion & Perspective
categories.useWhen: Niche opinions/tips on specific psychological phenomena or conditions (e.g., ADHD, anxiety) from a personal/reflective standpoint — NOT general self-help, NOT clinical information articles

geo._comment: Thresholds & targets read by scoring nodes. Recalibrate after ~10 first articles based on score_breakdown column in article_log sheet.

models._comment: Model mapping per role (CP 013). Outline→Groq (free), Schema→Ollama (local 127.0.0.1), Guard→Z.ai. Sisanya paid via various providers. WAJIB pakai 127.0.0.1 untuk Ollama, BUKAN localhost — di Windows ini 'localhost' resolve ke ::1 (IPv6) duluan dan Ollama cuma listen IPv4, menyebabkan ECONNREFUSED.

sheets._comment: Spreadsheet ID for topic queue & article log. See IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §4 for column list.

telegram._comment: Only for result notifications + error alerts. No approval gate (Wait node) in this workflow.
